source_notes: Kept as drawn: the string from the front hole to the front tag's top, and the peaked loop that rises from that corner to the back tag's top-left corner; the three strokes meet at about (42, 28); the loop and shoulder keep their fitted end points there, and the string ends 2 px short of its fitted end (review fix). The back tag's left shoulder stops about 2 px short of the front tag's right side (occlusion gap), and its bottom edge runs into the front tag's bottom-right corner with the small notch the sheet shows. The circuit keeps one stem, one rounded elbow down to the lower terminal and one branch right; the red top ring lies over the black stem, as on the red sheet. Red placement follows the red sheet.
